current_arc: The Monsoon Car Ride & Secret Pouch

history.title: തിരിച്ചുവരവ് (The Homecoming)
history.summary: After two long years of waiting, Reenu stands anxiously with her friend Amal at Kochi CIAL arrival terminal. Sachin emerges through the sliding glass doors, leading to an emotional, tearful reunion. However, Sachin nervously clutches a secret leather pouch from London.
history.cliffhanger: As Sachin holds Reenu close, his eyes reveal a hidden anxiety while his fingers tightly clutch a secret, unopened leather pouch.

history.title: മഴയും ചില രഹസ്യങ്ങളും (Rain and Some Secrets)
history.summary: Sachin, Reenu, and Amal exit the Kochi airport into a torrential downpour. As they navigate the rain-soaked streets in Amal's car, Reenu grows suspicious of Sachin's intense, nervous attachment to his leather pouch. A sudden jolt causes the pouch to disappear under the seat, sparking a moment of intense confrontation.
history.cliffhanger: As the pouch slides away, Reenu confronts Sachin about his strange behavior, leaving the secret of the bag hanging in the air.

history.title: ഒരു തട്ടുകട ചായയും നോട്ടങ്ങളും (A Roadside Chai & Unspoken Glances)
history.summary: Amal pulls the car over at a quaint, misty tea stall near the Kerala backwaters. As the rain continues to pour, Sachin and Reenu step out under a shared umbrella, finding a moment of quiet connection over steaming hot tea. Despite the proximity, Sachin struggles to find the right words to address the tension from their earlier argument. The episode culminates in a shift of focus as Amal discovers the misplaced leather pouch on the floor of the car.
history.cliffhanger: Amal picks up the mysterious leather pouch from the car floor, his expression shifting from curiosity to concern.

history.title: മറന്നുപോയ ഓർമ്മകൾ (Forgotten Memories)
history.summary: As the car glides through the misty streets of Kochi, Sachin and Reenu revisit the nostalgia of their college days. However, the weight of Sachin's two-year absence in the UK creates an unspoken distance. Sachin struggles with his guilt, while Reenu finds herself increasingly suspicious of his sudden departure.
history.cliffhanger: Reenu confronts Sachin, asking why he really booked his flight home so suddenly, leaving the truth hanging in the air.

history.title: രഹസ്യം പുറത്തേക്ക് (The Secret Slips)
history.summary: As the trio gathers, Amal hands over a mysterious travel pouch to Sachin. Reenu, already suspicious, presses Sachin about its contents. Sachin stammers and tries to change the subject, but his awkwardness only fuels Reenu's curiosity. The tension culminates when Reenu reaches out to touch the pouch, and Sachin instinctively pulls it away, leaving an uncomfortable silence between them.
history.cliffhanger: Reenu looks at Sachin with newfound hurt and confusion, realizing he is hiding something significant.
